lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Hello, Friend.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Do you remember me?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: It's Snow Crane.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I finally figured out how to use this messaging thing everyone's been on lately,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: and you're the very first person I reached out to.
Goodness!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Goodness?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: What? Did something happen?
No, I'm just surprised.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Surprised?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: About what?
I honestly figured you wouldn't be able to text,
since you're not exactly great with phones.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Haha. Yes, I suppose that's fair.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'm pretty clueless when it comes to modern developments,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: so I can see why you'd think that.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: But even I can handle something as small as this.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: It's called Bla, correct?
Yep.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: It's my first time using Bla,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: but I have texted on a phone before.
I'm impressed.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: My goodness, I can't believe you think I'm impressive.
Should I keep it to myself next time?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: No, not at all!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: It's just that I'm usually the one giving compliments,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: so being on the receiving end feels really wonderful.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'll have to be even more generous with my compliments to everyone from now on.
Good idea.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Then allow me to say,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: you're doing absolutely great today, Friend. Just like always.
What do you mean? I didn't do anything.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: You were so polite in responding to my messages.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: My Bla messages, I mean, which I realize came out of nowhere.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I truly appreciate it.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: If I were there with you right now, I'd be patting your head.
You can always do it for an extra long time when we see each other again.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Oh, what a wonderful idea!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'll absolutely do that.
Haha, sounds good. See you around.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Until next time, Friend.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Oh!
There is no response from Snow Crane for a while.
You okay?
Again, no response.
Snow Crane?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't find the button to close the app.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Which one am I supposed to press?
Try tapping the little < arrow next to my name.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Okay.
Once again, no further messages come from Snow Crane.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Oh my goodness! I did it!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: So that's how you exit from this app.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: A new piece of knowledge unlocked!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Hehe, there really is something new to learn every day.
Glad you figured it out, hahaha.
All right, goodbye for real this time.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Yes, of course. See you around, Friend!
